data_roles.history_for_state: Understat Big5 2014-2022, chronological PIT; outcomes released kickoff+3h; same-kickoff batch isolated
data_roles.scored_development: 2020-2022 only; expected n=5478; already consumed labels
data_roles.2019_or_earlier: state warmup only; no parameter selection

mechanism.name: per-team online continuation-vs-reset adaptive memory
mechanism.hazard_interpretation: fixed structural prior mean run length 20 completed matches; no grid
mechanism.continuation_profile_source: pre-existing V5 medium_balanced constants, inherited without retuning
mechanism.reset_prior: league attack/defence zero-mean state with prior_variance=0.30
mechanism.posterior: at each completed observation compare continuation and reset Poisson predictive likelihoods, Bayes-update reset probability, update both components, then moment-match; target match never updates before prediction

pre_1x2_gate.metric: mean joint Poisson one-step negative log predictive density on scored 2020-2022 rows
pre_1x2_gate.comparator: same inherited continuation filter with reset hazard forced to zero
